## About
Greenway Ford Body Shop is the collision center at Greenway Ford on E. Colonial Drive in Orlando. We handle collision repairs and auto body work, and we try to make the whole experience less stressful from the day you bring your car in.
We believe you should know your rights after an accident. You choose the collision center that repairs your vehicle, you choose the type of parts used, and you can review the completed estimate before any work begins. We recommend Original Ford Parts because they are made specifically for your Ford.
Reviewers often mention Luis Guzman and Isaiah by name, for keeping them informed and explaining the repair process along the way. We're rated 4.1 from 200 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision repairs: Repairs after an accident, with a completed estimate you can review before work begins.
- Auto Body Repairs: Body work that brings your vehicle back to how it looked before the damage.
- Collision Guide: A downloadable guide on what to do after a collision and how the repair process works.

## FAQ
Q: Can my insurance company make me use a different shop?
A: No. You have the right to choose the collision center that repairs your vehicle. The insurance company can't force you to go to one of their choosing.

Q: Do I get a say in which parts are used?
A: Yes. You have the right to choose the type of parts used in your repair. We recommend Original Ford Parts for fit, finish and durability.

Q: Do I have to leave my car right away?
A: No. You don't have to release your vehicle to begin the repair process before you're ready. Be sure to review the completed estimate before repairs begin.

Q: When is the body shop open?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM. Saturday, 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Closed Sunday.
